text: 11月14日，证监会主席吴清在参加2026中国资本市场学术年会时表示，2024年以来，社保、保险、年金净买入A股超1.5万亿元，专业机构力量稳步壮大，指数、ETF等产品供给持续丰富，长钱长投的制度体系不断完善；融资端，发行上市、并购重组、再融资等制度包容性适应性持续提升。今年前九个月，股票、债券等直接融资占社会融资增量的比重已近50％。（人民财讯）
text_en: On November 14, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that since 2024, social security funds, insurance funds and annuities have net purchased more than RMB 1.5 trillion of A-shares; the strength of professional institutions has grown steadily; the supply of products such as indices and ETFs has continued to enrich; and the institutional system for long-term money and long-term investment has been continuously improved. On the financing side, the inclusiveness and adaptability of systems for issuance and listing, M&A and restructuring, and refinancing have continued to improve. In the first nine months of this year, direct financing through equities, bonds and other channels accounted for nearly 50% of the increase in total social financing. (People's Financial News)
